name: MatMulU8ZeroPoints
adaptation: Compute all six signed INT32 entries C[i,j]=sum(k=0..7,(A[i,k]-Za)*(B[k,j]-Zb)). A is a row-major 2x8 UINT8 matrix, B is row-major 8x3 UINT8, and Za/Zb are supplied scalar UINT8 zero points. The subtractions are signed mathematical integers in [-255,255], not byte subtraction. There is no saturation, bias, scale, requantization or overflow. Output is row-major 2x3, 32 bits per entry. This is ONNX MatMulInteger, not an uncorrected unsigned dot product.
